patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with dark backgrounds are used throughout the page, often featuring large, centered text blocks for emphasis.
A dramatic contrast is established between oversized, elegant serif headings and clean, legible sans-serif body text, with smaller uppercase labels used for secondary information.
A high-contrast palette is used, dominated by deep charcoal/black backgrounds, bright red accents for CTAs and key highlights, and crisp white or light off-white for primary text.
A dynamic hero transition occurs on initial scroll, where a full-screen video hero completely disappears, revealing a new, persistent header and the main content sections.
Testimonial cards are presented in a scattered, rotated arrangement and animate into view with a subtle reveal as the user scrolls down the page.
Portfolio items are displayed in a clean grid layout, with each item featuring a distinct visual and a clear call to action.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen video hero that transitions out of view on scroll, replaced by a new, persistent header and the main content area, creating a distinct visual shift.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, ensuring a smooth and engaging content progression.
Testimonial cards are individually rotated and positioned, then animated into their scattered layout as the user scrolls, likely using a staggered reveal effect for each card.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with clean, legible sans-serif body and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous in hero sections and between major content blocks, becoming more balanced in grids and lists.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dramatic, full-screen video hero that completely transitions out to reveal a new, persistent header and content, combined with the playful, scattered, and animated testimonial cards, creates a memorable and dynamic user experience that feels more interactive than a typical marketing site.
